blind.description: A stylized fantasy/medieval market stall crafted from chunky brown timber, featuring four vertical corner posts, a lower front counter board, and an upper display counter. Over the top hangs a fabric canopy with alternating red and warm cream stripes and scalloped edges that drape down front and back. Displayed on the counter shelf and on the floor in front are various ceramic earthenware items, including large terracotta amphorae/jugs with handles, smaller green glazed jars, and lidded cream-colored pots.
blind.from_above: A rectangular canopy of alternating red and cream vertical stripes with four square wooden post-tops visible at the corners, beneath which several terracotta and green pot rims peek out along the bottom edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 5 ft tall (slightly shorter than the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 4.5 ft wide.
